verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a REST API with a published OpenAPI 3.0 spec and a versioning policy. Its MCP docs also describe an API-key authentication mode for setups with no browser, explicitly covering CI jobs, scripts and servers. Together these support headless, scripted automation against the platform. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI-native integration (e.g. a GitHub Action or pipeline examples), complete documentation of the API-key headless flow (the snippet is truncated), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
